enchantments.tooltip: Doubleshot 5%: Passive: 5% Enhancement bonus to Doubleshot. (Doubleshot is a chance to score an additional hit with a ranged attack.)
Speed +25%: +25% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 11% bonus to attack speed.
Quality Distant Diversion +2%: +2% Quality bonus to decreased threat generated from ranged damage.
Insightful Dexterity +3: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Dexterity.
Mythic Belt Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
